description: FamilySearch tree person read for Patrick Flynn — the isolated case: no relatives, no attached source descriptions. Shape follows person-read-tool-spec.md's Output section: the top level is always { persons, relationships, sources }, never a bare person object. Facts carry both sidecars the tool emits (`standard_place` from the place resolver, `standard_date` from stdDate), and neither is a string copy of its raw field — FamilySearch standardized names drop "County" and stdDate renders `~1845` as `Abt 1845` — so a run that re-derives either instead of keeping what the tool returned is visible in the written tree. Every person carries the `ark` the tool lifts from FamilySearch's Persistent identifier, and the single name carries `preferred: true` — both are fields person_read always emits for a tree read, and a tree written without the ark leaves no person in the project linked back to FamilySearch. The predicate is personId alone: person_read always reads relatives and sources and ignores both flags.
